web_fixture.snippet: The options cindermill has retired or renamed, with the release each change landed in: remote_verify was deprecated in 2.7.0, replaced by verify_mode.
web_fixture.content:
# Deprecations

This page lists cindermill options that have been retired or renamed, with the release in which the change landed. A configuration that still sets a retired option keeps working until the next major line, and `cindermill doctor` prints a warning for each one it finds.

## Retired options

| Option | Deprecated in | Replacement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| remote_verify | 2.7.0 | verify_mode |
| upload_retries | 2.4.0 | retry_policy |
| cache_quota_gb | 3.1.0 | cache_quota |

## Renamed options

| Option | Deprecated in | Replacement |
| --- | --- | --- |
| daemon_socket | 3.3.0 | control_socket |

Removal lands one major line after deprecation, so nothing in the tables above is gone yet.

Last reviewed 2026-05-14.

web_fixture.snippet: How we replaced the older verification flag across forty pipelines, and what the config files look like now.
web_fixture.content:
# Migrating our cindermill checks to verify_mode

*Posted 2026-03-27 by Halvard Nyström · Laddercrest Build Engineering*

We finished moving every pipeline off the older verification flag this week. The flag still works, but it logs a warning on every job, and the deprecations page records the release that started those warnings. Here is what changed for us.

## The config diff

Every job that set the old flag now sets `verify_mode: strict`. Nothing else moved.

## What we would do differently

The warning is easy to filter out, which is why it took us a quarter to notice it at all. Do not filter it.
